summary:
Delays’ second album, *You See Colours*, was released by Rough Trade on 6 March 2006. After keyboardist Aaron Gilbert lost the band’s demo copies, singer Greg Gilbert invited other members to contribute to the songwriting. The album was recorded at three UK studios with producer Graham Sutton.

Shifting from the guitar-focused sound of their 2004 debut, the record blends indie rock and pop, with catchy melodies, synthesizers and an emphasis on Greg Gilbert’s vocals. Critics generally responded favourably, praising its production and musicianship; it scored 73 out of 100 on Metacritic from eight reviews.

The album reached number 24 on the UK Albums Chart. Its lead single, “Valentine,” released on 20 February 2006, peaked at number 23 in the UK. “Hideaway,” released on 9 May, reached number 35. Stylus ranked “Valentine” fifth among its singles of 2006, while Obscure Sound placed the album at number 50 on its year-end list.
